children: Hercules Capital elected Alfred B. Fichera as an independent Class I director, effective September 17, 2026, and he will serve on the Audit Committee.
Independent Class I Director; member of the Audit Committee
Board expanded from seven to eight directors to fill vacancy

Former KPMG partner (1982–2019), Global Head of Alternative Investments; expert witness since 2021; independent director and audit committee chair at Warburg Pincus Access Fund since Sep 2025; B.S. in Accounting, CPA (inactive)
Will serve on the Audit Committee
